# Code of conduct

This project follows the
[Contributor Covenant 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

Be constructive, assume good faith, and critique methods, evidence, writing,
and code without attacking people. Harassment, discrimination, disclosure of
private research material, and retaliation are not tolerated.

Report conduct concerns privately to the maintainer through a channel listed
on the repository profile.
